new.obligation: Private frontier starts with exactly the caller word in seen and FIFO queue, one shared immutable Rc<Vec> payload, no tree and zero check count. charge.signature: fn charge(&mut self, limit: usize) -> Result<(), ContinuationError>
charge.obligation: If checks>=limit return WorkLimit BEFORE increment; otherwise increment by1. Since limit<=usize::MAX, checks<limit implies checks+1 fits. Each attempted adjacent position is charged, including equal letters, inadmissible swaps and already-seen neighbors; no conclusion from exhaustion.

register.obligation: Given one adjacent swapped candidate, query by Vec value without allocation. Existing member does nothing. Fresh member requires seen.len()<max_words before insert; create ONE owned Vec payload inside Rc, share it between ordered seen and FIFO queue, append original from word/position/actual swap witness as the required owned tree output. No mutable key alias or pointer-order comparison. Original BFS insertion/discovery order preserved.

trace_admission.obligation: First word length cap and max_words==0 refuse WorkLimit even with invalid start/alphabet. expand_word.signature:
fn expand_word(

    mode: ReplayMode,
    pairs: usize,
    limits: TraceLimits,
    frontier: &mut TraceFrontier,

expand_word.obligation: Scan every position ascending, charge BEFORE certification, then skip inadmissible edges. Equal symbols yield only self-edge, skipped after full charge/certification. For eligible unequal symbols lazily create one scratch Vec per expansion, swap only adjacent positions, register relative to original word, and restore scratch before next position. Newly stored words deep-copy scratch once and then share immutable payload; tree.from remains original word, never scratch. Failure drops provisional frontier without a result.

trace_component.obligation: Admit initial word and pair budget; initialize frontier. Pop FIFO, expand all positions; resource refusal aborts rather than returning partial component. verify_trace.obligation: Recompute full canonical component for externally expected start/word/mode/limits and require full structural equality of every member and ordered discovery witness. Removing a member, changing original tuple/mode, edge fields or order fails CertificateMismatch; resource/domain errors propagate before comparison. invariant_argument: Initially root is full enabled by admission, seen={root}, queue contains root, tree empty; all Rc keys immutable. Fresh registration comes only from a valid prefix swap on a seen word. Both orders enabled and equality of raw endpoints or all protected futures ensures the old enabled suffix stays enabled after interchange. Word length and each event count are preserved; edge reversal uses same prefix and symmetric endpoint/future equality, so graph reachability is connected-component equivalence at the fixed start/mode.

Seen contains only reached words (induction on fresh edges), queue contains each discovered unprocessed word once, tree has exactly one actual witness for each fresh non-root word. Processed nodes have all mode-eligible neighbors already seen; equal-symbol self-edge adds nothing. Scan order, FIFO and freshness by lexical value reproduce original canonical tree. Scratch starts original word, is restored after each attempted distinct swap, and never aliases seen key storage.

For finite word length L>=2 every queue pop consumes at least one bounded checked attempt or refuses; checks strictly increases below finite usize limit. For L0/1 there are no positions/fresh nodes and one initial pop finishes. Providers terminate on finite admitted tables. Thus every call returns a complete class or typed refusal. Set membership also confines successful discovered words to finite permutations and max_words; no silent truncation or loop progress based on unbounded recursion.

If queue empties without error, every seen neighbor has been examined or is a self-edge, giving closure. Reachability induction then puts every graph-reachable node in seen; soundness gives reverse inclusion. This is the concrete source refinement for Lean complete_component premises, not merely an assertion of closure from shared tests.

All node keys are Rc<Vec> immutable; registration deep-copies scratch only for a genuinely new word and stores Rc clones (at most seen+queue/local pop strong references per word). No Rc cycle, unsafe mutation or external reference exists. Rc::unwrap_or_clone cannot panic on unexpected sharing and appears outside adjacency loops; successful exhausted frontier has unique seen payloads. Required tree.from/initial output fields remain separate owned Vec values by public schema.

cost_review: Let L word length,K reached words,C=K*max(L-1,0) attempted checks on successful closure, n machine states,a alphabet,N=n+1. Bounds admit L<=max_word_len,K<=max_words,C<=max_swap_checks; overflow of checks prevented by guard. Error may stop earlier. Limits do not certify bytes/time; already supplied machine/input storage and allocator behavior are outside them.

Each check replays a prefix O(L), certifies four fixed short runs and at most one complete quotient. Quotient comparison work has safe bound O(N^2*(a+1)*log(N+1)), storage O(N^2+N*(a+1)). If a candidate is distinguished, provider BFS visits P<=N^2 pairs, conservative O(a*P^2+a*P*log(P+1)) work and O(P^2+P*a) storage including path copies. Thus total O(C*(L+quotient+BFS)) plus word set comparisons, not O(C) or bounded solely by pair count.

Ordered seen lookup costs O(L log(K+1)) worst-case scalar comparisons. Scratch allocated at most once per expanded word needing unequal admissible swap, O(K*L) cumulative copies instead of old per-position scratch. Fresh word payload allocated/copied once, shared between queue/seen by constant-size Rc clones; O(K*L) payload storage and O(K) Rc/tree/queue overhead. No duplicate queued Vec payload or scratch clone per adjacency.

Required output discovery tree stores K-1 from words plus actual SwapCertificate witnesses, O(K*L+sum witness sizes). Registered witnesses are Independent and carry no distinguishing word in successful tree, so here swap fields fixed size. Initial word field is required owned output; sorted members reuse each Vec via Rc::unwrap_or_clone after queue exhaustion. Tree.from copies are required public output, not redundant scratch.
